description: This file defines the LoadedProperty class, which implements the PropertyReflection interface for PHPStan code analysis tool. It models a property within a class, providing metadata about its type, accessibility, and other attributes.

classes.name: LoadedProperty
classes.description: Implementation of PropertyReflection representing a property in a class, with fixed accessibility and type information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LoadedProperty with its declaring class, type, and writability.

methods.name: getDeclaringClass
methods.description: Returns the class that declares this property.

methods.name: isStatic
methods.description: Indicates whether the property is static; always returns false.

methods.name: isPrivate
methods.description: Indicates whether the property is private; always returns false.

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Indicates whether the property is public; always returns true.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates whether the property is readable; always returns true.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the property is writable, based on constructor argument.

methods.name: getDocComment
methods.description: Returns null indicating no documentation comment.

methods.name: getReadableType
methods.description: Returns the type of the property.

methods.name: getWritableType
methods.description: Returns a NeverType indicating this property is not writable.

methods.name: canChangeTypeAfterAssignment
methods.description: Indicates whether the type can change after assignment; always false.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Returns a TrinaryLogic value indicating the deprecation status; always no.

methods.name: getDeprecatedDescription
methods.description: Returns null indicating no deprecation description.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Returns a TrinaryLogic value indicating if the property is internal; always no.
